summary: Backend name registry — maps string names to Backend factory callables. Provides register(name, factory) and get(name, **config). Currently a placeholder; no backends self-register here in production code.
extension_points: register(name, factory) — extension authors can register custom backends here
lifecycle_notes: Docstring says 'populated in Phase 4 once IbisBackend and IcebergBackend exist' — suggesting incomplete wiring.
IbisBackend and IcebergBackend do NOT currently self-register here — this registry is empty at runtime.
risks: Registry is populated manually — no auto-registration of built-in backends. get('ibis', ...) will raise KeyError at runtime.
Distinct from the settings DATABASES_REGISTRY in core.settings.registry — naming overlap may confuse.
open_questions: Is this module intended to replace the two separate Backend entry points (IbisBackend, IcebergBackend) with a unified factory pattern?
Should built-in backends auto-register on import?
